title: The Indian Temple That Scientists Can't Understand
description:

Hidden in the heart of Ellora, the Kailasa Temple is an architectural enigma carved entirely from a single rock. This documentary unravels the temple’s astonishing construction, exploring theories about how ancient artisans sculpted the colossal structure with primitive tools. We journey through its intricate carvings, breathtaking pillars, and epic legends connecting it to celestial powers. From debates on alien intervention to the brilliance of Indian craftsmanship, discover why the Kailasa Temple continues to baffle historians and scientists alike.

Special thanks to Tushar Gohil for providing the drone footage.
